display_long_description:
TruckX is an immersive VR truck simulator and truck driving game for Meta Quest. Get behind the wheel of powerful trucks, complete delivery jobs, earn money, explore scenic roads, and build your trucking career.

Experience realistic truck driving in VR with first-person controls, traffic, toll plazas, police checkpoints, parking areas, fuel stops, traffic violations, and truck maintenance. Manage your journey and expenses while taking on different delivery routes.

Build your fleet by purchasing new trucks, upgrading your vehicles, unlocking routes, and completing more challenging deliveries. Whether you enjoy truck simulation games, driving games, or immersive VR experiences, TruckX puts you in the driver's seat for an engaging trucking adventure.

Features
• VR truck simulator experience
• Immersive first-person truck driving
• Multiple trucks to purchase and drive
• Delivery jobs and career progression
• Scenic roads and diverse environments
• Unlockable routes and destinations
• Truck upgrades and customization
• Fuel and maintenance management
• Traffic, toll plazas, and police checkpoints
• Parking and traffic violations
• Earn money through deliveries
• Explore the road at your own pace
